records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Contract liabilities relate to advance consideration received from customers or advance billings for which revenue has not been recognized and are reduced when the associated revenue from the contract is recognized.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The revenue recognized during the three months ended March 31, 2025 and 2024 that was included in contract liabilities at the beginning of the period amounted to $74,189 and $105,472, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As a result, the Company has classified the results of operations as discontinued operations in the condensed consolidated statements of earnings and the condensed consolidated statements of cash flows for the three months ended March 31, 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Depreciation expense totaled $38,669 and $37,826 for the three months ended March 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended March 31, 2025 and 2024, amortization expense was $48,749 and $43,945, respectively.
